seller.name: Khador
seller.offer:
Just a word, Mr. Maxwell. I have stolen a few hours from these disturbances, and I hoped I might find you here. The Khador Drive, you see, has one flaw: it leaves nothing at all between the departure and the arrival. I believe you humans call this... missing the scenery? So I have held the fold open. Mounted, the #N will carry your ship through an orbit at great speed, and out of the system altogether, into the dark between the stars.
According to our calculations it is 97% reliable. Unfortunately, there is always a residual risk. I would be honored if you took the blueprint, for a modest #C. And I must trouble you for one unit of chromo plasma: there is a considerable likelihood that nothing else will hold the fold. Might we say we have an agreement?
seller.thanks: Excellent! I believe I am experiencing what you humans call relief. You have my utmost gratitude, Mr. Maxwell. Do carry your regular Khador drive on board also, just in case. I would hate to think of you stranded between the stars. And should Dr. Paolini ask, you have not seen me here.
seller.known: Ah, Mr. Maxwell! How very nice to see you. I trust the fold is holding? Should you observe any residual risk, my humble self would be most interested to hear of it. From a safe distance, of course.
